notes: GCF LORTA midline evaluation of the SLEM project (Conservation International), clustered randomized phase-in (51 Phase 1 vs 50 Phase 3 COBAs), baseline early 2019, midline late 2022, 1654 households re-interviewed. PDF page 1 is a ResearchGate cover. Adoption outcomes are in Table 4 (p.7): impact (ITT, LATE, DiD) and Phase 3 control mean per practice. Extracted agroforestry (trees_in_farmlands, type unspecified) and soil conservation (coded other: undefined, not CA as defined). ca_bundle tag not confirmed: the paper's 'conservation agriculture practices' are a basket (soil conservation, agroforestry, terracing, resistant crops, multi-crops, irrigation, off-season rice, storage, pest management, saving groups) with no tillage/residue practice. Not extracted: terracing, resistant crops, multi-crops, irrigation, off-season rice, storage, pest management, saving groups, 'at least one practice' and number of practices (not defined practices; terracing could be 'other' if the team wants SWC). Table 7 (p.10) heterogeneity gives only significance stars (agroforestry ** in CAZ), no values - not extracted. Income/expenditure effects (Table 5, MGA, inverse hyperbolic sine) are project-level, not attributable to a practice - not extracted as cost_return. No carbon income data. The treated-group adoption rate (control mean + impact) is not printed and was not computed.

adoption.driver: Assignment of the household's COBA to SLEM Phase 1 (intention to treat)
adoption.geography: Ankeniheny-Zahamena (CAZ) and Ambositra-Vondrozo (COFAV) forest corridors, eastern Madagascar
adoption.locator: Table 4, row "Agroforestry used at midline", column group "ITT", column "Impact"
adoption.note: Std. error 0.04 (in the row below the estimate; no error column in adoption table). Impacts are marginal effects from probit (table note); share of households. Obs. = 1640. Text (Results 5.2) says '4 to 5 percentage points at 1 per cent level, except for DiD' and abstract/conclusion say agroforestry 2-6 pp; table taken. Note the ITT star (***) is hard to square with the printed SE (0.04 on 0.04). Agroforestry type not described in the paper (parkland, alley, boundary or shade systems not distinguished; project nurseries produced 'agroforestry seedlings'); coded trees_in_farmlands on the synonym - flag.
